1:1.note: Title 'words of Nehemiah son of Hachaliah' omitted; Ketiv/Qere mapped.

1:3.note: Plus 'these men whom I asked'; הנשארים אשר נשארו = 'those men who escaped'; plus 'behold', copula, 'dwell', 'much', 'and behold'.

2:1.note: 'I was cupbearer before the king' for 'wine before him'.

2:3.note: 'house of the kingdom' for 'house of graves'.

2:6.note: 'queen sitting by him' rendered loosely; 'how long will you go and come'.

2:8.note: 'to make' for 'to make beams'; 'gates of the house'.

2:14.note: 'gate of the wadi' for 'fountain gate'; 'pool' rendered 'aqueduct'.

3:1.note: Syriac reads ויבנו as 'and his sons', adds 'upon'; 'they sanctified it' transposed.

3:2.note: First 'built' omitted; second בנה read as 'sons of'; בן minus.

3:4.note: 'Hand' rendered 'border'; 'son of Berechiah' fused in Syriac.

3:6.note: 'Old gate' rendered 'gate of two' (ישנה read as שנים).

3:8.note: Plus 'son' before goldsmiths; 'until the broad wall' rendered 'when its wall was widened'.

3:10.note: Second 'and (at) the border repaired' belongs to ועל ידו החזיק (was linked to the first clause); נגד rendered 'great'.

3:11.note: פחת rendered 'great'; 'tower of ovens' rendered loosely.

3:15.note: 'District' omitted; Shiloah rendered 'outlet of water'; K/Q both assigned.

3:17.note: Last phrase compressed; 'half district' omitted; Keilah apparently corrupted.

3:20.note: החרה rendered 'took'; Zaccai K/Q both assigned; 'from...to' rendered 'to...and to'.

3:25.note: Plus 'and up to' twice and 'of the plain'; אשר minus.

3:30.note: Plus doublet 'after him repaired Binnui son of Henadad a second portion' (cf. 3:24); 'chamber' rendered 'house'.

4:1.note: Paraphrastic: 'healing went up' rendered 'time was given ... to be built', plus 'to be built'; second כי minus.

4:5.note: Word-for-word, 'come into their midst' rendered 'fall upon them'.

4:6.note: ויהי כאשר minus; plus 'behold now ... they came to fight with you'; ܐܝܠܝܢ ܕ = אשר.

4:7.note: Plus 'they came ... to fight with you in their troops'; 'I stationed the people' rendered 'they divided the army'; obscure 'lowest places / bare places' minus.

4:8.note: וארא read as 'I feared'; 'wives and houses' minus; repeated 'for' plus.

4:9.note: Plus 'the matter', 'went up', 'were working all of us'.

4:10.note: Plus 'onward, half of the people' and 'stood'; 'all the house of' minus; שרים rendered 'servants'.

4:17.note: 'Each his weapon (to) the water' replaced by 'except one who reached a month of days' (plus).

5:4.note: Plus 'and we work' and 'and we live'.

5:5.note: Expansive paraphrase with pluses 'and there are who say', 'so also', 'slavegirls', 'possessions are given'; ואין לאל ידנו rendered 'they do not raise their hands before God'.

5:7.note: Plus 'I stirred my spirit'; rest of MT verse (usury, assembly) is rendered within Syriac 5:8.

5:8.note: Speech blocks of MT 5:7b and 5:8a transposed: first 'I said to them' = 5:7, second (after the assembly, read as 'voice') = 5:8; בנו apparently read as 'their sons'; כדי, ונמכרו לנו minus; plus 'therefore', 'to me'.

5:9.note: מחרפת paraphrased 'because you act like the deeds (of the nations)'; 'our enemies' rendered 'who are around us'; plus 'to them', 'now'.

5:10.note: Plus 'we sell' and 'to the poor among our people'.

5:11.note: 'Hundredth' minus; plus 'let us leave to the rest of the people'.

5:12.note: 'We will restore and not seek' minus; plus 'and I said to them, thus and not to do'.

5:13.note: חצני minus; נערתי read as 'children' (plus 'small'); ܥܠ ܡܠܬܐ for את הדבר; plus 'and all the people stood', 'all'.

5:14.note: End recast after Num 16:15/1 Sam 12:3: 'I was head to them and did not take the ass (ܚܡܪܐ, in the slot of לחם) of any of them, nor harmed any of them'.

5:15.note: Plus 'much for tribute', 'and they ruled over them and oppressed them'.

5:18.note: Opening paraphrased with plus 'the man who made bread for the workers'; 'for one day' minus.

6:2.note: Plus 'to me', 'let us go'; כפירים rendered 'like a band'; Ono read as 'which is'.

6:7.note: Plus 'behold' and the name 'Ezra' as the proclaimed king.

6:11.note: Compressed: 'far be it from me (= לא) to flee and enter the temple'; 'who like me ... and live' minus.

6:12.note: Expanded: plus 'against me', 'nor (was it) by a prophet (for הנבואה) said to me', 'to kill me', 'and his companions ... sent him against me to kill me'.

6:16.note: וייראו read as 'feared'; 'fell in their eyes' rendered 'were greatly shaken before us'.

6:18.note: Plus 'that they would not harm him'.

7:1.note: Plus 'and the gates stood' before 'the doors were set up'.

7:2.note: Plus 'was' and 'and turned aside from evil' for מרבים.

7:3.note: 'Heat of the sun' rendered 'the day rises'; ויאמר/ואמר (K/Q) both assigned.

7:5.note: Plus 'in it'; 'and the people' (10) rendered as genitive 'of the people'.

7:7.note: Word-for-word; some names variant (Nahamani as Nehemiel).

7:30.note: Order of Ramah/Geba reversed; 721 for MT 621.

7:34.note: 'Other' minus; 'sons of' rendered 'of the house of'.

7:59.note: Pochereth-hazzebaim split into two families (plus 'sons of').

7:61.note: Addon and Immer read as 'these said'.

7:65.note: Tirshatha rendered 'elders of the priests'; plus 'great'; Urim and Thummim rendered 'ask and see'.

7:69.note: Tirshatha rendered 'elders of the priests'; plus 'of the house'.

8:3.note: 'Before the square' (5,6) minus; plus 'and before those who heard', 'attentive to the commandments'.

8:4.note: Plus 'stood' twice; 'for the purpose' rendered 'that he might speak upon it'.

8:9.note: Tirshatha rendered 'head of the priests'; plus 'and they said', 'for'.

8:10.note: 'Fat' and 'sweet' minus; plus 'for it is a day of' and 'shall be'.

8:15.note: Tree names differ (oil-tree as walnut, myrtle as citron, thick tree as willows); plus 'in the book of the law of Moses'.

9:4.note: מעלה rendered 'head'; names differ, Bunni minus; 'cried' rendered 'prayed'.

9:8.note: 'Made a covenant' rendered 'swore oaths'; plus Hivites and 'to him', 'with him'.

9:17.note: 'Stiffened their neck' minus; 'appointed a head' rendered 'turned their heart'; K/Q both assigned.

9:30.note: 'Peoples of the lands' rendered 'peoples of the cities'.

9:32.note: ל prefixes rendered as separate ܥܠ.

9:36.note: First הנה rendered 'therefore'; עבדים doubly rendered 'like servants working'; plus 'like', 'in its midst'.

10:2.note: ועל read as וכל, החתומים rendered obscurely 'those who ... of us'; Tirshatha rendered 'elder'; plus 'head of the priests'; names differ.

10:16.note: Bunni read as 'sons of'; Adonijah, first in MT 10:17, placed here.

10:29.note: Plus 'they shall come' and 'they'; Nethinim rendered 'servants'.

10:32.note: Free expansion: שבר read as שכר ('whoever hires out a beast ... wage he shall not take', לא נקח doubled); משא rendered twice (burden on the sabbath / what they owe us); plus 'we shall not carry', 'because it is holy'; release clauses reordered.

10:34.note: 'Sin offerings to atone for Israel' rendered 'forgiveness of the sins of Israel'.

10:35.note: 'Father's house ... to burn on the altar' (12-22) minus; plus 'Lord', 'book'.

10:38.note: תרומתינו rendered 'threshing floors'; 'chambers of the house' rendered 'before'; plus 'who minister', 'we will give'.

11:1.note: 'Princes' rendered 'elders'; plus 'sons of men', 'shall be'; 'hands' rendered 'of them'.

11:2.note: 'Volunteered' rendered 'who willed of their own mind'.

11:4.note: ישבו minus; names partly differ (Hodaiah, Nethaniah).

11:17.note: יהודה read as 'of the Jews'; K/Q both assigned.

11:21.note: Paraphrase: Nethinim as 'their servants', and 'each at his work and his plough' replaces Ophel/Ziha/Gishpa (plus).

11:24.note: 'At the king's hand' paraphrased 'he was ruler over all whom the king said' (relative clause plus).

12:8.note: Binnui read as 'his sons'; על הידות rendered 'thanksgiving'.

12:24.note: 'Man of God' rendered 'prophet of the Lord'; 'brothers' moved before 'son of Kadmiel'.

12:25.note: 'Guard at the storehouses of the gates' minus.

12:27.note: 'At the dedication' rendered 'when ... was completed'; 'harps' minus.

12:36.note: 'Man of God' rendered 'prophet, servant of the Lord'.

12:38.note: Second thanksgiving rendered 'they gave thanks'; למואל read 'from above'; plus 'went up', 'stood', 'high, above'; wall rendered twice; 'ovens' rendered 'great'.

12:39.note: Plus 'from ... to'; Meah rendered 'high'; sheep gate rendered 'gardens'; guard gate rendered 'great gate'.

12:44.note: Paraphrastic: plus 'who were giving ... to the king'; שדי read as שרי ('heads of the towns'); 'contributions' minus; plus 'book'.

12:47.note: Plus 'bring out and give'; דבר minus.

13:4.note: Abbreviated: 'and Eliashib the priest came'; rest of MT verse (chamber, Tobiah) minus.

13:7.note: 'Courts of the house of God' rendered 'court of the Lord'.

13:13.note: 'To distribute to their brothers' rendered 'their lot came up to be head over their brothers'.

13:16.note: Tyrians minus; recast as prohibition: 'do not bring fish, do not buy (מכר), do not sell (ומכרים) on the sabbath'.

13:21.note: 'Lodge before the wall' paraphrased 'you do not enter until day rises, at the gate of the wall' (grouped on לנים); plus 'this matter'; proleptic ܡܢܗ ܡܢ.

13:22.note: Word-for-word, 'keepers and gates' as two nouns.

13:24.note: Negation (5) minus: 'half know how to speak Judean'.

13:25.note: 'Plucked out their hair' rendered obscurely; plus 'woe'.

13:31.note: Wood rendered 'holy things'; plus colophon 'finished the writing of the book of Ezra the scribe'.
